title: Cloudflared Process Killed (No Forwarding Address)
style: industrial dub techno, 124 bpm, 336 hz subharmonic, smoke-room hiss, terminal cursor blink as percussion, low male monotone, datacenter hum bed
lyrics:
[Intro]
ctrl c, ctrl c
the pipe is gone, no reply

[Verse 1]
woke the laptop, link is dead
whole subdomain, off the thread
friend hits refresh, gets a wall
no forwarding address at all

[Pre-Chorus]
no cache, no mirror, no archive
ephemeral means it didn't survive

[Chorus]
cloudflared process killed
no forwarding address filed
spun it up to share a thing
closed the lid, killed everything

[Verse 2]
named tunnel costs you nothing more
token in a config, that's the door
pages free tier holds the load
or a workers route on a real road

[Chorus]
cloudflared process killed
no forwarding address filed
spun it up to share a thing
closed the lid, killed everything

[Outro]
next time pin it, next time stay
or watch your demo walk away
